watch.en: Cut the pieces to one size and shape.
watch.de: Die Stücke in einheitlicher Größe und Form schneiden.

why.en: Pieces of one size cook evenly and make the dish look better.
why.de: Gleich große Stücke garen gleichmäßig und lassen das Gericht schöner aussehen.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Knife Skills, section Uniformity & Consistency
sources.sentence: A uniform size will give the dish a better appearance. Uniformity in size means the product will cook evenly.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3.10 Vegetable Nutrition, Storage and Preparation
sources.sentence: Vegetables should be carefully cut into uniform shapes and sizes to promote even cooking and provide an attractive finished product.
